purpose: Pronunciation lexicon: the single source of truth for how the voice says clinical and uncommon terms. British English. Synced to Cartesia by spike/scripts/lexicon.py --sync; never edited in Cartesia directly. Every synthesis script applies it and refuses to run if the dictionary on Cartesia differs from this file.

fibrosis.note: APPROVED DEFAULT, by the maintainer's ear 2026-09-24: the voice's own rendering is correct. The 2026-09-22 alias 'fye-BROH-sis' was made from phoneme reports without listening and introduced the error (methodology §20). No dictionary entry is sent for this term; it stays in the lexicon so its approval is recorded and its salt is in the cache key.
fibrosis.candidates_note: 2026-09-24: the << >> phoneme markup is read as letters by Sonic 3.6, so IPA with a stress mark is not available through this model. Viable respellings all give the same reported phonemes; stress and rhythm are only audible. Word duration in the sentence is 0.88-0.96 s for every viable candidate, and 1.4-2.2 s for any word placed at the end of the carrier sentence: the long durations are sentence-final lengthening, not the alias.

OET.note: APPROVED DEFAULT, by the maintainer's ear 2026-09-24: he prefers the voice's own rendering and its speed over every letter candidate (c1-c7 on the review page). The 2026-09-23 terms check heard the default as 'oat'; the maintainer chose it knowing that. No dictionary entry is sent for this term; it stays in the lexicon so its approval is recorded and its salt is in the cache key.

candidates.why: current entry: correct letters, too slow
no alias at all: the default, which the terms check heard as 'oat'
full stops, no spaces: letters run together (maintainer asked for O.E.T. variants, 2026-09-24)
letter names joined by hyphens, said as one fast unit

OET.candidate_sentence: One warning for your OET letter.

COPD.note: Initialism. Read as a word by default (terms check, 2026-09-23).

approval_rule: A term is used in a lesson only after the maintainer has approved its rendering by ear on the lexicon review page. approved is set by `lexicon.py --approve TERM --by NAME`; an unapproved term in a page's text blocks synthesis.

kinds.alias: a dictionary entry sent to Cartesia
kinds.default: approved as the voice's own rendering; no entry is sent, the term is recorded so approval and cache salt apply
